messages:
nina (Billing): FYI we have a client (GammaHealth) on Slack — they received an invoice missing the overage detail row and the totals don't match the usage export.
raj (Finance): Uh oh. Which invoice id?
matt (Sales): INV-2026-03-GH per their screenshot. They said AP flagged it as 'amount mismatch' and paused payment.
billing-bot: invoice-generator | job_2026_03_2330 | status: completed_with_errors. error: 'render_mismatch:expected_items=3,rendered_items=2'
ops-bot: pipeline | usage-aggregator | run_id: ua_98765 | status: success | notes: truncated_description_flag=true
ela (Engineering): Jumping in. I pulled the raw payload — the usage pack contained three items but one description contained a tab char which after templating collapsed the cell. The renderer's sanitiser then removed the row as 'empty'.
nina (Billing): Which item collapsed? We need the overage row back (code: overage_model_compute).
ela (Engineering): It was overage_model_compute. Raw amounts show: subscription=8000, overage_model_compute=2400, embeddings_extra=180. PDF only showed subscription and embeddings_extra.
raj (Finance): Can we re-issue quickly? Customer is withholding payment. Also we should avoid sending two invoices if we re-run. Use v2 suffix and mark original as corrected.
ela (Engineering): Will re-run job with a sanitize-fix flag that preserves cells with non-printable chars replaced. Creating job job_2026_03_2330_fix.
billing-bot: invoice-generator | job_2026_03_2330_fix | status: completed. invoice_id: INV-2026-03-GH-v2 | PDF: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-2026-03-GH-v2.pdf
matt (Sales): I notified the customer and sent the corrected PDF. They confirmed it resolves their question.
raj (Finance): Record: mark original invoice INV-2026-03-GH as 'corrected' with pointer to v2, and add a note for audit that amounts unchanged, only formatting fix.
nina (Billing): Filed follow-up ticket for a template test to cover tabs/newlines and add a pre-render validation to fail rather than drop rows.
ela (Engineering): I'll add the validation + unit test. Rolling patch to prod tonight.
matt (Sales): Customer will process payment once they receive the corrected invoice; I'll follow up tomorrow.
raj (Finance): Thanks. Closing once payment reconciles. :white_check_mark:
